what: The cote 91 Work folders are filed under SA02 but re-read SA03's Pro pages: K91-02 (19-20, the Ext obstruction) with A01-A06; K91-03 (34) with B01; K91-04 (47-48) with B27-B28; K91-05 (59) with N059; K91-06 (73-74) with N073-N074; K91-07 (87) with N087; K91-08 (99) with RN099; K91-09 (114) with RN114; K91-10 (129) with RN129. Pairs of independent readings for sweep 2, across the SA02/SA03 boundary.
Cote 91 is split between SA02 (scans 2-18) and SA03 (19-143); the Hom-functor items SA02-12 and SA03-2 are one subject.
The crystal programme pages parallel Chapter V "Programme" of the Montreal notes (1970 course, published 1974), by the notes' comparison with the French edition; the notes do not date the sheets.

Cote 93 holds an offprint by Marcus Wanderley ("Théorie axiomatique de l'orientation des variétés topologiques à bord") with handwritten orientation sheets; a link to the topology topics (SA21, SA11), not to Gauss-Manin.
The notes propose bridges to cotes 159 and 64; they are proposals, not on the pages.
